sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Twenty-five selected parameters retain the preceding retention-site draws exactly. Reverse-carbonation factor is fixed at one, with permeability, pore radius, condensation factor, evaporation A/E and staged atmosphere also fixed. No reverse-kinetics or atmosphere-range robustness follows. Eight paired samples and unqualified physical/process cases yield exploratory rankings only; no measured material or qualified-process optimization. The ordered-structure viscosity barrier is fixed at 80000 J/mol; the same preceding 25 paired draws are retained. This does not establish robustness across the additional barrier range or identify that parameter. The dry-fraction modulus exponent is fixed at two; its range and correlation with reference modulus are not covered or identified. The matrix phase eigenstrain amplitude is fixed at 0.02; its signed range and correlation with phase kinetics or stiffness are not covered or identified. The coupled algebraic zero-relaxation limit is outside scope. Phase modulus contrast is fixed at four; neither its range nor its correlation with eigenstrain, porosity stiffness or phase kinetics is covered or identified. Disordered-minus-ordered heat capacity contrast is fixed at 10 J/mol/K; its range and correlations are neither covered nor identified. Phase conductivity contrast is fixed at two; its signed range and correlations with phase kinetics, baseline conductivity, moisture and pore radiation are not covered or identified.

thermodynamics.elastic_storage: F_el=K(D/V,C)*V0*epsilon^2/2; K=K0*((D/V)/(D0/V0))^m*exp(-g*C); C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0; epsilon=V/V0-1-beta(T)-B(n,x)-eta+e0; K0*(e0-m*e0^2/2)=prestress; S_el=K*V0*beta'(T)*epsilon at fixed x,n; U_el=F_el+T*S_el. F_V=K*epsilon+V0*K_V*epsilon^2/2; mu_el_i=V0*K_D*epsilon^2*v_dry_i/2-V0*K*epsilon*B_ni-V0*g*K*epsilon^2*C_ni/2; -F_eta/V0=K*epsilon drives sintering. Direct D partials hold C and B fixed; Bdot and Cdot retain carrier birth and phase relaxation in U/S and equilibrium; Kdot=K_V*Vdot+K_D*Ddot-g*K*Cdot.
